faqs: Can you help shape an early idea?
Yes. We can begin with discovery, release priorities, and a prototype before agreeing on a development scope.
Can you improve an existing product?
Yes. An initial review helps identify technical constraints, useful improvements, and a practical modernization plan.
How long will a project take?
Duration depends on scope, integrations, feedback, and release requirements. Milestones and estimates are agreed after discovery.
Source code ownership, repository access, third-party licences, and handover deliverables are documented in the project agreement.
Do you offer support after launch?
Yes. Maintenance, improvements, and support responsibilities can be agreed separately or included in the engagement.
